pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
plays_over: the rest upper body (girl_idle_* frame 0, or girl_walk_upper / sneak / side-step, whose right arm is steady) on any lower; during the sprint, swap the arm state directly
hold_note: while it plays, hold the idle on its frame 0 so the shoulder matches the rest arm
flashlight_note: flashlight_tip / flashlight_angle_deg are the drawn values (deg out from straight ahead)
clip_note: the flashlight comes up from the low carry (frame 0 = girl_*_arm_right_off's rest arm) to the raised aim (frame 5 = girl_*_arm_right_on's rest arm). Play it backwards to lower the light; switch the arm state at the end of the clip
